Properties.DebugString: PAL: “But even that way is guarded! As Sir Arn sees shadowy assassins springing forth from the darkness! Defend yourself!”
Without the slightest attempt at steath, the guards spot him immediately
PAL: “It was a lot more fun when you played the role properly. It’s not just about winning and losing, you know. We’re trying to tell a story together here, remember?”
PAL: “If you are going to cheat, so am I. Now you are stuck. Sir Arn can’t progress any further.”
PAL: “As Sir Arn nears Morganna’s inner sanctum he hears a sinister growling. What does the Sorceress have in store for him?”
PAL: “Morganna has called upon diabolical powers to defeat her nemesis, Sir Arn. Powers that allow her to transform herself! Still yourself, Sir Arnie!"

PAL: “The evil Morganna uses the power of the dragon orb to transform herself into… A DRAAAAGGGOONNN!" “Her fiery breath is death! Her scales form an impenetrable armor! What will Sir Arn do against this invincible foe?!”

PAL: “I’m…sorry, Arnie. That was probably a little too much. I hope you are okay. I guess I just got a little frustrated that the game wasn’t playing out the way I imagined it. I’ve been thinking about it for so long…”
PAL: “If you are going to cheat, so am I. Now you are stuck. Sir Arn can’t progress any further.”
PAL: “Sir Arnie stumbles in lively ball Morgana holds in her own honor.”
PAL:“Sir Arn finds his way inside the castle walls! Before him is the court yard and the entrance into Morganna’s castle!”
PAL: “To aid you in your journey ahead, take this health potion”
PAL: “Ahhhh… Sir Arn has stumbled upon a secret chamber. Who knows what ancient secrets are found within?”
PAL: “Sir Arnie stumbles in lively ball Morgana holds in her own honor.”
